title: Delhi Police says no permission for SKM’s protest march to Jantar Mantar

ai.summary: Delhi Police prohibited SKM's planned protest march to Jantar Mantar without permission, citing prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the BNSS, 2023.

facts.claim: Delhi Police prohibited unauthorised gatherings and demonstrations in the New Delhi district
facts.quote: The Delhi Police has prohibited unauthorised gatherings and demonstrations in the New Delhi district, citing the imposition of prohibitory orders

facts.claim: No application for permission for the march was received
facts.quote: no application seeking permission for the proposed march has been received

facts.claim: Prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the BNSS, 2023 are in force
facts.quote: Police said prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, are in force in the New Delhi district

ai.background_note: Delhi Police prohibited SKM's planned protest march to Jantar Mantar without permission, citing prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the BNSS, 2023.
